units.source_text: 师姑藤壶皇后关念皇太子前程，其忧伤之深，自不必说。

en.t: Needless to say, Lady Fujitsubo, now a nun and empress, was deeply saddened as she worried about the Crown Prince's future.

units.source_text: 她和源氏公子既有宿缘，自然不能漠不关心。

en.t: Since she and Prince Genji were bound by a karmic tie from the past, she naturally could not remain indifferent.

units.source_text: 惟多年以来，只因深恐世人诽议，所以处处小心谨慎。

en.t: Yet for many years, because she deeply feared the slander of the world, she had been cautious in every respect.

units.source_text: 如果对公子略示情爱，外人定将抨击，因此只得隐秘在心。

en.t: If she showed the prince even the slightest affection, outsiders would surely condemn her, so she had no choice but to keep it hidden in her heart.

units.source_text: 每遇公子求爱，大都只当不知，冷酷对付。

en.t: Whenever the prince sought her love, she usually pretended not to notice and treated him coldly.

units.source_text: 所以世人虽然爱管闲事，好议是非，但关于此事，始终没有片言只语。

en.t: Thus, although people in the world loved to meddle and gossip, not a single word was ever said about this matter.

units.source_text: 能够太平无事，半是由于公子不敢任情而动，半是由于皇后能巧避人目，努力隐藏之故。

en.t: That everything remained peaceful was partly because the prince did not dare act on his feelings, and partly because the empress skillfully avoided people's eyes and did all she could to conceal the matter.

units.source_text: 如今危惧已去，但回想当年，安得不又伤心，又思念。

en.t: Now that the danger and fear had passed, how could she look back on those days without feeling both grief and longing again?
